paper_title: Achieving 19% Power Conversion Efficiency in Planar-Mixed Heterojunction Organic Solar Cells Using a Pseudosymmetric Electron Acceptor
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2022 - Gao - Achieving 19  Power Conversion Efficiency in Planar‐Mixed Heterojunction Organic Solar/auto/Advanced Materials - 2022 - Gao - Achieving 19  Power Conversion Efficiency in Planar‐Mixed Heterojunction Organic Solar.md

knowledge_points.content: BS3TSe-4F is a pseudosymmetric electron acceptor designed by regio-selectively replacing two sulfur atoms in the central and lateral positions of the BP4T-4F pi-core with selenium atoms.
knowledge_points.evidence: By regio-selectively replacing the two sulfur atoms in the central and lateral positions with selenium on the π core of previously reported BP4T-4F, the typical molecular packing mode of Y6 derivatives is maintained.

knowledge_points.content: A ternary PMHJ organic solar cell based on D18/BS3TSe-4F:Y6-O (1:0.1 weight ratio) achieved a record power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 19.03% with a VOC of 0.845 V and a JSC of 29.41 mA/cm².
knowledge_points.evidence: By incorporating another mid-bandgap acceptor Y6-O into D18/BS3TSe-4F to form a ternary PMHJ... realize an impressive PCE of 19.03%... with an enhanced VOC (0.845 V) and FF (76.56%).

knowledge_points.content: The asymmetric selenium substitution in BS3TSe-4F increases the dielectric constant (εr) of the D18/BS3TSe-4F blend to 2.80, which is significantly higher than the 2.15 observed for the D18/S9TBO-F blend.
knowledge_points.evidence: Figure 1d shows the εr values of D18, S9TBO-F, BS3TSe-4F, D18/S9TBO-F, and D18/BS3TSe-4F, which are 3.94, 2.36, 2.50, 2.15, and 2.80, respectively, under the frequency of 10^5 Hz.

knowledge_points.content: The exciton binding energy of the D18/BS3TSe-4F blend (0.381 eV) is lower than that of the D18/S9TBO-F blend (0.495 eV), facilitating more efficient exciton dissociation.
knowledge_points.evidence: corresponding exciton binding energies... giving... 0.495 eV for D18/S9TBO-F and 0.381 eV for D18/BS3TSe-4F... significantly lower exciton binding energy of D18/BS3TSe-4F than that of D18/S9TBO-F should benefit efficient exciton dissociation.

knowledge_points.content: The binary PMHJ organic solar cell based on D18/BS3TSe-4F achieved a PCE of 18.48%, with a VOC of 0.828 V, a JSC of 29.40 mA/cm², and a fill factor (FF) of 75.94%.
knowledge_points.evidence: As a result, PMHJ OSCs based on D18/BS3TSe-4F achieve a PCE of 18.48%... with a VOC of 0.828 V, JSC of 29.40 mA cm−2, and FF of 75.94%.

knowledge_points.content: In these materials systems, Planar-Mixed Heterojunction (PMHJ) devices exhibit higher PCEs than Bulk Heterojunction (BHJ) devices (e.g., 18.48% vs 16.14% for BS3TSe-4F), likely due to poor morphological compatibility in the BHJ blend of highly crystalline materials.
knowledge_points.evidence: D18:BS3TSe-4F-based BHJ OSCs showed significantly lower PCEs... (16.14% for D18:BS3TSe-4F) than those obtained from PMHJ OSCs... most likely due to poor morphology compatibility between the highly crystalline donor and acceptor materials.

knowledge_points.content: BS3TSe-4F-based devices exhibit a lower radiative recombination loss (ΔE2 = 0.053 eV) compared to S9TBO-F-based devices (ΔE2 = 0.062 eV), which helps compensate for slightly higher non-radiative losses.
knowledge_points.evidence: its lower radiative recombination loss (ΔE2, 0.053 eV compared to 0.062 eV for D18/S9TBO-F) helps compensate this disadvantage and leads to a lower Eloss in its derived device.

knowledge_points.content: DFT calculations show that molecular asymmetry in BS3TSe-4F reduces electron-hole overlapping in certain dimer packing patterns (e.g., Dimer D2 at 0.241), indicating a stronger tendency for free charge generation compared to the symmetric S9TBO-F.
knowledge_points.evidence: Theoretical calculation results show that pseudosymmetric BS3TSe-4F has a stronger tendency to generate free charge carriers than S9TBO-F... electron-hole overlapping of Dimer D can be further minimized in D2 (0.241).

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS characterization indicates that D18/BS3TSe-4F films possess a 'face-on' orientation with coherence lengths (CLs) of 77 Å in the in-plane (IP) direction and 20.4 Å in the out-of-plane (OoP) direction.
knowledge_points.evidence: CLs in IP and OoP directions are 77/20.4 Å for D18/BS3TSe-4F and 64/19.4 Å for D18/S9TBO-F... all possess 'face-on' orientation.

knowledge_points.content: BS3TSe-4F has a narrow optical bandgap (Eg opt) of 1.280 eV with an absorption onset extending to 969 nm, and its HOMO/LUMO energy levels are -5.60 eV and -3.86 eV, respectively.
knowledge_points.evidence: corresponding to an optical bandgap (Eg opt) of 1.294 and 1.280 eV, respectively... HOMO energy levels... identified as -5.24, -5.61, and -5.60 eV... LUMO energy levels of -3.00, -3.84, and -3.86 eV.

knowledge_points.content: The charge carrier mobilities in D18/BS3TSe-4F PMHJ devices are more balanced than in D18/S9TBO-F, with an electron mobility (μe) of 3.3 × 10⁻³ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and a hole mobility (μh) of 5.4 × 10⁻³ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹.
knowledge_points.evidence: electron (μe) and hole (μh) mobilities... were 3.3 × 10−3 and 5.4 × 10−3 cm2 V−1 s−1 for D18/BS3TSe-4F with μe/μh of 2.3 and 0.6, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: RSoXS data revealed that D18/BS3TSe-4F:Y6-O ternary films have a higher volume fraction (63%) of smaller domains (~30 nm) compared to D18/S9TBO-F (42%), correlating with higher JSC and FF.
knowledge_points.evidence: Volume fractions of smaller domain are D18/BS3TSe-4F:Y6-O (63%) > D18/BS3TSe-4F (61%) > D18/S9TBO-F (42%), and the higher volume fraction of this domain will result in higher JSC and FF.
